stories.title: Teen wanted in a serious shooting in Connecticut arrested in Mesa
stories.summary: The New Haven Police Department wanted the 17-year-old for a September shooting that critically injured another juvenile.

stories.title: Grand Canyon hotels will reopen as water access is restored
stories.summary: Overnight lodging will resume at facilities in the South Rim of the Grand Canyon on Nov. 20.

stories.title: Enjoy the cooler temperatures and sunny skies in Arizona
stories.summary: An extended, very preliminary look ahead to Thanksgiving Day shows sunny skies in the Valley with temperatures in the low 70s.

stories.title: 'It's going to hurt' | Queen Creek residents will face higher water bills due to new fee
stories.summary: Queen Creek residents face higher water bills as the town council implements a new fee to secure groundwater supplies for future generations.

stories.title: Car crashes into Ahwatukee yogurt shop, leaving owner facing weeks of repairs
stories.summary: The owner of Yoasis says her shop remains open nearly a week after a driver accidentally crashed through the storefront, causing extensive damage.

stories.title: Phoenix man arrested for sex crime he allegedly committed in 2023
stories.summary: A man was arrested after his DNA matched the one obtained from the victim's forensic sexual assault exam, according to court documents.

stories.title: “I’ve never wanted to find something so bad”: Silver Bell Estates man finds missing toddler near Eloy
stories.summary: After drones and helicopters failed to spot the 2-year-old, a longtime resident searching on foot found her hiding in a desert bush. She is now home safe.

stories.title: 'This takes more power away': AZ corporation commissioners push back against rushed ethics overhaul
stories.summary: Three Arizona Corporation Commissioners say they did not have time to vet a proposed rewrite of the Code of Ethics. One commissioner exited the room.

stories.title: Helicopter deployed to help injured hiker on Camelback Mountain
stories.summary: The hiker reportedly sustained an injury near the top of the Echo Canyon trail.

stories.title: North Mountain Park will be closed until 2028 for $30M renovation project
stories.summary: The project, the park's biggest in about 40 years, will add a playground, new restrooms, more shade and more parking.

stories.title: Several 'smash-and-grab' car burglaries reported in Sedona
stories.summary: Hikers in the Sedona area recently had their cars burglarized, according to the sheriff's office.

stories.title: Man taken to hospital after being found unconscious in Chandler pool
stories.summary: A woman reported she found her husband unconscious in a pool near Cooper and Ocotillo roads, Chandler police said.
